style: Say smoothly and warmly, like a writing teacher reading over your shoulder.
lines: Tap a topic chip and a move chip. Watch which passages light up.
Now tap a meaning chip. Checks show where it fits.
That promise covers too much. Tap a narrower chip.
One line can't carry a whole essay. Tap a wider chip, or Any.
A crossed passage cuts against your claim. You'll have to answer it in Prove.
Tap Use as evidence on three lit passages, then finish each Because box.
Here is your paragraph. Edit it in the box, then tap Copy.
Finish each Because box. Name words from its quote and explain how they link to your meaning.
The popular reading has to get past these four lines.
Tap Use this one to choose three passages and explain your reading.
Build a thesis and tap Use this one. Then choose evidence in Prove before editing your draft.
No passages are lit. Tap Tune the thesis, then choose a topic and a wider move.
Tap Tune the thesis. Choose a topic, a move and a meaning in Build.
Tap a topic, a move and a meaning before using this thesis.
Edit the paragraph, or tap Prove to compare it with your revised evidence.
